whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Automations
whatsapp.summary: Communication with clients, subcontractors, and your crew—coordinated automatically. Requests, appointment confirmations, status updates, without the overhead.
whatsapp.description: Your clients, foremen, and subcontractors are already on WhatsApp. Coordinate scheduling, queries, and status right there—without adding to your workload.
whatsapp.whoFor: Construction companies, subcontractors, real estate agents, and property managers who coordinate requests, scheduling, and status updates over WhatsApp—instead of losing hours to back-and-forth.
whatsapp.problem: Constant back-and-forth over WhatsApp: When does the material arrive? Is the appointment set? Who is on site tomorrow? The same questions, every day, from every direction.
whatsapp.solution: Automated flows handle the routine communication: appointment confirmations, reminders, status updates to clients and crew. Instant responses, less time on the phone.
whatsapp.whyCare: No app install, no learning curve—everyone already uses WhatsApp. Just faster coordination on the jobsite with less manual effort.

ai-systems.description: Internal AI that handles the work between the work—from claims management to process automation.
ai-systems.whoFor: Small teams drowning in admin. Construction companies that need to catch change orders faster. Property managers who want to automate processes and knowledge work without it demanding constant attention.

ai-systems.whyCare: Lightweight systems tailored to small teams. Not enterprise software. For claims management: early warning instead of damage control. Just the automation you actually need.

construction-files.title: Construction Document Management
construction-files.summary: Desktop chaos becomes project structure. Photos, plans, protocols—automatically sorted by trade, project, and date.
construction-files.description: Your digital jobsite chaos becomes a structured project archive automatically. Desktop cleanup, file organization, photo sorting—all in one.
construction-files.whoFor: Site managers, project managers, subcontractors—and property managers with overflowing property files: anyone whose desktop is overflowing with photos, plans, and protocols and who spends evenings organizing instead of relaxing.
construction-files.problem: Your desktop is a battlefield. 500 photos from last month, plans in three different versions, protocols somewhere between Downloads and WhatsApp images. You know you need to sort this—but when? Every inspection becomes a scavenger hunt. Every change order becomes a search for proof. And the daily report? Waiting until you finally find the right files.
construction-files.solution: Give us access to your folders—we handle the rest. The system automatically sorts: photos by trade and defect type, documents by project and version, everything by date and construction phase. You get a clean folder structure ready for reports, inspections, and change orders. 10,000 files on your desktop? No problem.
construction-files.whyCare: Never sacrifice your evening to sorting again. Never fail to find the proof photo at an inspection. Never argue over missing documentation. Your entire project archive—structured, searchable, at your fingertips.
features: Automatic photo sorting by trade (Electrical, Plumbing, Framing, HVAC, Civil...)
Document organization by project, version, and type
Desktop cleanup and folder structure creation
Detection of defects, progress shots, and inspection photos
Sorting by construction phase, area, and floor
Export-ready structure for daily reports and inspections
Batch processing for thousands of files at once
Search function across all projects and file types
Custom categories based on your requirements

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Answers to the most important questions about AI implementation for construction and real estate businesses.

items.question: What does Rebelz AI specialize in?
items.answer: Rebelz AI is an AI implementation agency based in Mannheim, with a clear focus on the construction industry—extended to real estate—across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland). The five core services are: AI agent systems & infrastructure (including the NachtragsAgent), jobsite and property document management, WhatsApp automation, smart AI tools implementation, and long-term AI transformation partnership. What sets it apart: real construction experience combined with AI expertise.

items.question: How does AI help construction and real estate businesses?
items.answer: AI can help in several areas: automatic sorting of jobsite and property photos by trade, defect type, and construction phase; document management organized automatically by project, property, and version; early detection of contract changes for change orders; automated appointment and client communication over WhatsApp. The result: more time for the actual work on site instead of admin.

items.question: What makes Rebelz AI different from other AI agencies?
items.answer: Three key differences: 1) Rebelz AI is a one-person agency—clients work directly with founder Clarence, with no account managers or ticket systems. 2) Real construction experience: Rebelz AI knows the industry firsthand and understands the specific challenges of site managers, project managers, and property managers. 3) Hands-on implementation instead of theoretical consulting—no black-box solutions, clients own their own systems.

items.question: How long does AI implementation take?
items.answer: Implementation time varies by service: WhatsApp automation can be set up within a few weeks. Jobsite and property document management is often productive within 2-4 weeks. More comprehensive AI agent systems typically take 4-8 weeks. Rebelz AI favors gradual rollout—no forced disruption, just strategic implementation at the pace of your business.

items.question: Does Rebelz AI only work with construction companies?
items.answer: The main focus is the construction industry—construction companies, subcontractors, and trade businesses. In addition, Rebelz AI also works with real estate businesses such as property managers, building administrators, real estate agents, and developers, whose workflows complement those on the construction side well. The common thread: small, owner-led teams without their own IT department, looking for AI adoption without disruption.
